name: Steve Gunn
caption: FWA's own reigning World Heavyweight Champion at the start of 1997, profiled in the fed's first newsletter before losing the title to King 3933540$ Perfect in a three-fall streetfight/Texas Death/I Quit main event.

tenures.source: FWA's own served 1997 cards and newsletter (promotions/fwa-association/archive/).

name: King 3933540$ Perfect
caption: Won the FWA World Heavyweight Championship from Steve Gunn in a three-fall main event refereed by a guest Sandman, representing "the Dark Empire."

tenures.source: FWA's own served 1997 cards and newsletter (promotions/fwa-association/archive/).

name: Malice
caption: FWA's own United States Champion, self-described as "the man without loyalty"; lost a barbed-wire ropes match to "Gangsta" Crush after a mystery interloper opened his throat on the top rope.

tenures.source: FWA's own served 1997 cards and newsletter (promotions/fwa-association/archive/).

name: "Gangsta" Crush
caption: Billed "Extreme Gangsta," beat Malice in a bloody barbed-wire match and was offered (and refused) a ceremonial World Title belt from Adam Lash afterward.

tenures.source: FWA's own served 1997 cards and newsletter (promotions/fwa-association/archive/).

name: "Lionheart" Adam Lash
caption: FWA's own Cruiserweight Champion, who presented "Gangsta" Crush with a ceremonial title belt and issued a challenge for a future card.

tenures.source: FWA's own served 1997 cards and newsletter (promotions/fwa-association/archive/).

name: "Ass Kicker" Adam Anderson
caption: FWA's own North American Champion as of February 1997.

tenures.source: FWA's own served 1997 cards and newsletter (promotions/fwa-association/archive/).

name: Psycho Sabu
caption: One half of FWA's World Tag Team Champions, Masters of Destruction, alongside Master Blaster.

tenures.source: FWA's own served 1997 cards and newsletter (promotions/fwa-association/archive/).

name: Master Blaster
caption: One half of FWA's World Tag Team Champions, Masters of Destruction, alongside Psycho Sabu.

tenures.source: FWA's own served 1997 cards and newsletter (promotions/fwa-association/archive/).

name: Psychio Damento
caption: An unseen attacker who cut Malice's throat open on the top rope mid-match, named only by a backstage reporter as a coming threat to Malice and "Gangsta" Crush.

tenures.source: FWA's own served 1997 cards and newsletter (promotions/fwa-association/archive/).

name: Lancer
caption: An FWA wrestler who, with The Hunter, invaded the FWA operator's own second promotion, MWCW, to attack Lobo and Ozzy Gruesome -- corroborated as ranked wrestler #133 on the 1997 RSPWF Top 200.

tenures.source: FWA's own served 1997 cards and newsletter (promotions/fwa-association/archive/).

caption: An FWA wrestler who, with Lancer, invaded MWCW to attack Lobo and Ozzy Gruesome, and separately wrestled Scott "Rage" McLane to a submission win with "The Bullseye."

name: Kip Thomas
caption: One of FWA's two in-fiction broadcasters, co-hosting its shows and the wider AOL community's own 1st Annual E-Wrestling Awards.
